name: freeform-two-callers
title: Two callers, one credential store
subtitle: Illustrative. A hosted agent and a laptop agent reach the same vendor through the same proxy
html:
{{icon:bot}}Hosted agent
signs each call with a service key
{{icon:terminal}}Laptop agent
signs in once in the browser
{{icon:shield}}Credential proxy
looks up the vendor token, adds it
{{icon:cloud}}Vendor files API
never sees the agent
